_comment: Two entries that resolve to one device node are one physical device, and a batch writes neither: the batch makes the check and reports what it refused, every entry sharing the node is refused rather than all but one, a device with no node never collides, the same entry listed twice is not a conflict, selection follows links before anything is compared, and every selection - the agent's and the CLI's, for each identity kind - hands the batch where it found the device.

mutations.name: the batch refuses entries that share a device
what the batch refused is reported with the failures
every entry sharing the node is refused, not all but one
a device with no node never collides
the same entry listed twice is a repeat, not a conflict
an entry is its type and its id, not its id alone
a refusal names the node the entries share
mutations.find: f"this is the same device as {named}: each resolves to {target.resolved_path}. "

mutations.name: selection hands the target where the device was listed
mutations.find: return dataclasses.replace(target, resolved_path=os.path.realpath(device.path) if device.path else None)

mutations.find: return dataclasses.replace(target, resolved_path=os.path.realpath(device.path) if device.path else None)

mutations.find: return dataclasses.replace(target, resolved_path=os.path.realpath(device.path) if device.path else None)
